content:
Zoe (PMM): Quick sync — need a set of 30s soundbites + SDR snippets for inbound + webinar comms. Focus: positioning vs cloud AI platforms, generic LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Goal: rebuttals, routing tags, and a tiny benchmark note. I dropped a doc: https://docs.google.com/example (please edit). Who can take point? :eyes:
Mateo (Growth): I can take SDR play + inbound routing. Will add segment routing rules and tag suggestions. cc @Priya for handoff signals.
Priya (AE): I’ll add the buyer objection snippets — we see different pushback from SRE/platform vs product teams. I’ll paste real call quotes.
Dan (Bench Eng): I’ll add a 1-slide micro-benchmark and three crisp latency/cost bullets. Quick Q: can we surface raw CloudX numbers or keep them directional?
ops-bot: Reminder — publishing third-party benchmark numbers requires legal review. See internal compliance checklist: https://confluence.example/legal/benchmarks.
Zoe (PMM): Good call — keep raw numbers out, use ranges/directional claims. @Ellie can you draft three one-liners: one vs cloud APIs, one vs infra vendors, one vs self-hosted runtimes?
Ellie (Content): On it. Drafts inbound to the doc: 
- Cloud APIs: "Predictable latency and reserved capacity for critical routes — not spotty burst credits."
- Infra vendors: "Unified runtime + built-in observability, so teams stop stitching custom stacks."
- Self-hosted: "Ship on private infra without losing hosted observability and rollouts."
I’ll keep them tight.
Priya (AE): Add an objection play: \"We already have CloudX endpoints\" -> \"Reserved capacity + SLOs for production-critical flows; we can guarantee tail latency with dedicated pools.\"
Mateo (Growth): Routing rules snippet (will paste into doc):
```yaml
route:
  - if: enterprise && sla_required
    target: dedicated-sales
  - if: trial && high_token_usage
    target: growth-touch
  - if: api_only && low_token_usage
    target: self-serve
```
Priya (AE): Love the tags: add `bench-conscious`, `cost-sensitive`, `reg-compliant` to lead metadata.
Dan (Bench Eng): Added micro-benchmark table and a short "do not claim" list: no absolute % claims vs named clouds, no promises on specific hardware vendors. Kept numbers as ranges (e.g., \"~30–70ms median on X config\").
Zoe (PMM): Timeline: finish drafts by EOD Friday, run by Legal + Sales leadership Monday, ship to SDR playbook next Tue. Everyone drop comments in doc. :rocket:
Ellie (Content): Posted 30s soundbites under "snacks" in the doc. Pinging for wording tweaks.
Mateo (Growth): I’ll map inbound routing to HubSpot properties once final. Will also add webhook tags for high-token trials.
Priya (AE): Quick ask — anyone have a headline for the webinar landing? Working: "Cut inference cost without giving up latency". Thoughts?
Zoe (PMM): I like that. Alternative: "Serve large language models reliably — without breaking the bank."
Dan (Bench Eng): Both solid. Suggest we A/B the registration copy and measure CTR.
ops-bot: Auto-backup saved doc to /marketing/content/edge-positioning-v1 (backup id: bk_2001234).
Zoe (PMM): Great progress. Final checklist: edits in doc, legal check, sales review, HubSpot mapping. Thanks team — sprint to EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
